title: Weyl callback verifier accepts empty output vectors
detail: Output shape is never checked. An empty result satisfies seed universal predicate and produces no zipped defects, yielding passes=true for a non-N-vector callback. Probability bound requires a fixed valid linear map and independent uniform samples. Fresh logical control C01 confirms the vacuity without invoking source. Underlying Weyl characterization remains valid in its stated domain.

title: Direct-script test entrypoints omit appended classes
detail: unittest.main appears before later classes in four files, omitting eleven methods in total under direct execution. Imported discovery includes them; archived logs explicitly name these later methods, so historical recorded runs are not negated. C02 records exact lines/methods/log hashes.

title: Some validators trust stored claims or permit omitted records
detail: Examples: phase12 verify_all checks cached ranks/booleans rather than recalculating matrices and only parses thresholds.json; phase35 saved-polynomial loops can be empty; separator ordinary-record check can be vacuous; optional numerical audit copied without freshness check; fixed test counts not discovered. Actual phase35 archived certificates N8/N16 are present, and three archived Fourier/Green witnesses independently reconcile. This does not establish actual false stored theorem data.

title: Root helper does not verify exact order for custom generators
detail: primitive_root_of_order checks w^n=1 only. C03 gives p17,n4,generator1 producing w1 of order1. Intended default prime/generator examples are not contradicted.

title: Floating diagnostics and cost proxies retain restricted meaning
detail: Float spectral/rank/tail checks are not interval certificates; planner total-minus-head can erase tiny mass (C04); Frobenius-optimal scalar need not be spectral-optimal; arithmetic/word proxies exclude stated setup, bit-width or verification work. Prime-free ring widths grow; approximate and structured-input results do not establish generic exact sub-NlogN FFT or unit-word cost.

title: Joint-orbit ZIP packaging is payload-consistent but not byte-reproducible
detail: ZipFile.write retains filesystem metadata; equal payloads with different timestamps need not have the same archive hash. C07 confirms independently. Fixed file list and post-write payload hashes otherwise avoid stale self-manifest duplication.
